sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:54

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:54:1
items.html: The light of Malchut in the vessel of Yesod: For after phase one of the light of Hod refined to the aspect of the root — that is, drawing only the level of the light of Malchut — the light was then given to the vessel of Yesod. And this is what he says, the light of Malchut in the vessel of Yesod. (And see above, page 336, in the Inner Light, the passage beginning “it returned,” where this was explained at length.)

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:54:2
items.html: The Vav entered the vessel of Yesod in the secret of the male of the Malchut that is there, for it is higher. For this Vav is of the level of phase one, as above; for after Bina refined to the level of phase one, she gave the above Hey, together with the light of Hesed, to the vessels of the VAK. And Hod, too, gave the above Hey to Yesod in the aspect of an illumination alone, and not through the refinement of phase one, as above in the words of the ARI (page 333, item 43). And after Hod illuminated the above Hey in it, it refined to the level of Malchut and gave this remainder of its own to Yesod. Thus the Vav of the Hey that Yesod took has a level of phase one, like ZA, and it is therefore the male of the vessel of Yesod toward the light of the level of Malchut that is in it, who is the female in it. “And this is what he says, that the Vav is higher by several degrees than the light of Malchut that is in Yesod”: the first, that it is the level of phase one, as above; and the second, that it comes from the coupling of the ZON of Bina, as above.
